metric: For each situation, select whole-domain cells at or above the 99th percentile of positive concentrations in that configuration's 8k fresh-emission field. Divide the 30k concentration sum by the 8k sum over those same selected cells.
minimum_is_over: six situation-wise ratios; minimum occurs in different situations for stock and patched

scope.selection: each configuration uses its own 8k hotspot sets

attribution: Historical F+S+late-NaNGuard bundle; motivation and convergence evidence, not a measured effect size for current PR #64.
code_differences: R7b uses optional SourceGroupBuffer<double>, SyncRoot locking and adds nonzero buffered values to the float field before Clear(). Current #64 uses double-array leaves and overwrites each float cell from its double accumulator before resetting. Both accumulate contributions from both particle loops in double precision.
do_not_claim: The historical six-situation effect size was reproduced on current PR #64.
All numbers are from an F-only run.
The stock and patched hotspot sets are identical.
